title: On the Dirichlet-to-Neumann conformal invariant of bounded planar domains
summary: Using an analogue of the Mandelstam-Giddings-Wolpert diagrams, we introduce a new canonical representative of the conformal class of a bounded domain of arbitrary connectivity in $\mathbb{C}$ as a flat conical surface with geodesic boundary (a "truncated light-cone diagram", simply LC-diagram in the sequel). The space of diagrams carries natural coordinates. We derive variational formulas for the determinant of the Dirichlet Laplacian on a LC-diagram with respect to these coordinates.
